points.description: States hydrolysis as one of the three steps, using this term.
States acidogenesis as one of the three steps, using this term.
States methanogenesis as one of the three steps, using this term.

rubric.notes: Full marks only if all three terms (hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis) are given with the correct technical names. A wrong extra step (e.g. acetogenesis listed as one of three, or any wrong item) costs a point. Vague descriptions without the technical term earn nothing; order does not matter.
